              HasDerivAt u E.zSolution 0 ∧

                    E.WelfareExpansion (F.compositeUtility P c) u s

∀ {n k h g r : ℕ}
  (F : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.BenchmarkFamily n k h),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (G : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (η : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec g)
      (hη : ∀ (a : Fin g), 0 < η a) (DG : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat g g),
      Matrix.IsSymm DG →
        ∀ (β : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec g),
          F.D = (F.nestData G η hη).demandMatrix DG →
            F.b = (F.nestData G η hη).proportionalPolicy β →
              ∀ (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n r)
                (RG : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Refinement P G) (C0 C : F.Candidate),
                P.mean F.p F.q ↑C0 = ↑C0 →
                  ∀ (i j : Fin n),
                    i ≠ j →
                      P.group i = P.group j →
                        ∀ (u : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec k) (t : ℝ),
                          ↑C = F.pairExchange C0 i j u t →
                            0 < 1 + F.pairMismatchDelta G η i j t * u ⬝ᵥ (F.model C0).K⁻¹.mulVec u ∧
                              (F.model C).lossCoefficient - (F.model C0).lossCoefficient =
                                F.pairMismatchDelta G η i j t * (u ⬝ᵥ (F.model C0).K⁻¹.mulVec (F.model C0).m) ^ 2 /

declarations.exact_type_from_lean:
∀ {n : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) {A : Type u_1} (O : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n → A)
  (c : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n)) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
  (∀ᵐ (e : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n) ∂μ, d.Admissible e ∧ O e = O c) →
    ∀ (a : ℝ),
      CommodityClassification.Information.predictionRisk μ d.normalizedWelfare a =
        (a - ∫ (e : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n), d.normalizedWelfare e ∂μ) ^ 2 +
          ProbabilityTheory.variance d.normalizedWelfare μ

  (c : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n),
  d.Admissible c →
    sSup (CommodityClassification.Information.compatibleRisks {e | d.Admissible e ∧ O e = O c} d.normalizedWelfare) =
      d.observationAnswerWidth O (O c) ^ 2 / 4

declarations.name: CommodityClassification.Precision.Data.observation_minimizedRisk_supremum
declarations.exact_type_from_lean:
∀ {n : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) {A : Type u_1} (O : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n → A)
  (c : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n),
  d.Admissible c →
    sSup
        {r |
          ∃ μ,
            CommodityClassification.Information.CompatiblePrior {e | d.Admissible e ∧ O e = O c} d.normalizedWelfare μ ∧
              IsLeast (CommodityClassification.Information.predictionRisk μ d.normalizedWelfare '' Set.univ) r} =
      d.observationAnswerWidth O (O c) ^ 2 / 4

declarations.exact_type_from_lean:

  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) {N : ℕ → ℕ}
  (E : (j : ℕ) → CommodityClassification.Precision.Data (N j)) (m : ℕ → ℕ),

      (∀ (j : ℕ), (E j).beta = d.beta) →
        (∀ (j : ℕ), (E j).sigma = d.sigma) →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun j => (E j).coarseSales (m j)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            ∀ eps < d.precisionFloor,
              ∃ t δ,
                0 ≤ t ∧
                  t < 1 ∧
                    δ = d.shareFloor t ∧
                      0 < δ ∧
                        ∀ᶠ (j : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                          ∀ (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition (N j) (m j)),
                            ∃ c,
                              (E j).Admissible c ∧

                                  (E j).theta c = (E j).theta (E j).criticalInputs ∧
                                    (∀ (i : Fin (N j)) (a : Fin 2),
                                        δ ≤ (E j).inputs (E j).criticalInputs i a ∧ δ ≤ (E j).inputs c i a) ∧
                                      eps < |(E j).normalizedWelfare (E j).criticalInputs - (E j).normalizedWelfare c|

declarations.name: CommodityClassification.Precision.Data.answer_endpoint_denominators
declarations.exact_type_from_lean:

    0 ≤ d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c) ∧
      d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c) ≤ d.secondMoment e ∧
        d.secondMoment e ≤ 1 ∧

    ∀ (c e : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n),
      d.Admissible c →
        e ∈ d.closedFiber P (d.groupTotal P c) →
          IsMaxOn d.secondMoment (d.closedFiber P (d.groupTotal P c)) e →
            d.sigma < d.eta →
              d.manuscriptAnswerWidth P (d.groupTotal P c) =
                CommodityClassification.Precision.Variance.growing (d.lossScale * d.theta c ^ 2) |d.eta - d.sigma|
                  (d.denominator d.sigma (d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c)) (d.theta c ^ 2))
                  (d.secondMoment e - d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c))

declarations.name: CommodityClassification.Precision.Data.answer_variance_growing_iff
declarations.exact_type_from_lean:
∀ {n g : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g),
  d.TypeRespecting P →
    ∀ (c e : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n),
      d.Admissible c →
        e ∈ d.closedFiber P (d.groupTotal P c) →
          IsMaxOn d.secondMoment (d.closedFiber P (d.groupTotal P c)) e →
            ∀ (eps : ℝ),
              d.sigma < d.eta →
                eps * d.denominator d.sigma (d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c)) (d.theta c ^ 2) <
                    d.lossScale * d.theta c ^ 2 →
                  (d.manuscriptAnswerWidth P (d.groupTotal P c) ≤ eps ↔
                    d.secondMoment e - d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c) ≤
                      eps * d.denominator d.sigma (d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c)) (d.theta c ^ 2) ^ 2 /
                        (|d.eta - d.sigma| *
                          (d.lossScale * d.theta c ^ 2 -
                            eps * d.denominator d.sigma (d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c)) (d.theta c ^ 2))))
